question: Simplify \(\sqrt{18}\) and \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).
solution: \(\sqrt{18}=\sqrt{9\times 2}=3\sqrt{2}\); multiplying the numerator and denominator of \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) by \(\sqrt{2}\) gives \(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\).
